            item.dataset.emoji = emoji.e;
            item.dataset.name = emoji.n;
            item.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
            item.onclick = function () {
                selectEmoji(emoji);
            };
            item.onkeydown = function (e) {
                if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    selectEmoji(emoji);
                }
            };
            emojiGridEl.appendChild(item);
            count++;
        }
    });
    resultCountEl.textContent = count + " 个 Emoji";
}
function selectEmoji(emoji) {
    selectedEmojiEl.style.display = "block";
    document.getElementById("bigEmoji").textContent = emoji.e;
    document.getElementById("infoEmoji").textContent = emoji.e;
    document.getElementById("infoName").textContent = emoji.n;
    const codePoints = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < emoji.e.length; i++) {
        const code = emoji.e.codePointAt(i);
        if (code > 0xffff)
            i++; // Skip surrogate pair
        codePoints.push("U+" + code.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(4, "0"));
    }
    document.getElementById("infoUnicode").textContent = codePoints.join(" ");
    const htmlEntities = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < emoji.e.length; i++) {
        const code = emoji.e.codePointAt(i);
        if (code > 0xffff)
            i++;
        htmlEntities.push("&#x" + code.toString(16).toUpperCase() + ";");
    }
    document.getElementById("infoHtml").textContent = htmlEntities.join("");
    // Copy emoji immediately
    copyToClipboard(emoji.e);
}
window.copyToClipboard = function (text) {
    return __awaiter(this, void 0, void 0, function* () {

            yield navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);

                statusEl.textContent = "";
            }, 2000);
        }
        catch (e) { }
    });
};

// Theme toggle
function toggleTheme() {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const currentTheme = html.getAttribute("data-theme");
    const newTheme = currentTheme === "light" ? "dark" : "light";
    html.setAttribute("data-theme", newTheme);
    document.getElementById("theme-icon").textContent = newTheme === "light" ? "☀️" : "🌙";
    localStorage.setItem("theme", newTheme);
}
// Load saved theme
const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || "dark";
if (savedTheme === "light") {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", "light");
    document.getElementById("theme-icon").textContent = "☀️";
}
